title: Maximum OR
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, you can multiply any element by 2 at most k times.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, you can multiply any element by 2 at most k times. Determine the highest possible bitwise OR value of the array after performing these operations.
constraints: One operation doubles one array element, and you may perform at most k operations total.
Return the maximum possible bitwise OR of all array values afterward.
Applying all k doublings to one chosen value is sufficient to consider for an optimum.
reference_solution:
def maximum_or_after_doublings(nums,k):
    suffix=[0]*(len(nums)+1)
    for index in range(len(nums)-1,-1,-1):suffix[index]=suffix[index+1]|nums[index]
    prefix=answer=0
    for index,value in enumerate(nums):
        answer=max(answer,prefix|(value<<k)|suffix[index+1]);prefix|=value
    return answer

def maximum_or_after_doublings(nums,k):
    suffix=[0]*(len(nums)+1)
    for index in range(len(nums)-1,-1,-1):suffix[index]=suffix[index+1]|nums[index]
    prefix=answer=0
    for index,value in enumerate(nums):
        answer=max(answer,prefix|(value<<k)|suffix[index+1]);prefix=value
    return answer
hints: Precompute suffix OR values and maintain a prefix OR while scanning candidate shifted elements.
For candidate i, combine prefix OR, nums[i] shifted left k bits, and the suffix after i.
Take the maximum across every candidate index.
Doublings only shift bits left; concentrating them avoids splitting away the highest attainable bit, and prefix/suffix OR includes every unshifted element exactly once.
editorial: Doublings only shift bits left; concentrating them avoids splitting away the highest attainable bit, and prefix/suffix OR includes every unshifted element exactly once.

tests.explanation: Shifting twelve once gives twenty-four, and 24 OR 9 equals thirty.
Shifting eight twice gives thirty-two; OR with one and two gives thirty-five.
